name: wan-huiyan-context-baton
description: Two skills for passing context across boundaries — session-handoff (end-of-session, agent→human) and successor-handoff (mid-run, agent→agent). Use together for work that outlives a single Claude context window.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: End-of-session handoff with built-in cross-session consolidation. Captures knowledge, updates documentation, and prepares next-session prompts.

plugins.name: successor-handoff
plugins.description: Mid-run agent-to-agent handoff for long autonomous workflows. Lean parent orchestrator + file-first subagents + successor dispatch when context pressure rises.
